run_mamba_chunk_scan_combined: run the mamba_chunk_scan_combined function to perform a chunked SSM forward pass with optional states and varlen outputs
run_mamba_chunk_scan_combined_fwd: run the _mamba_chunk_scan_combined_fwd function to execute the full 5-step Mamba2 chunked scan forward computation
